lattice.description: Runtime version that opened this stream

instances.description: The assembly it opened under: instance name -> component name. Recorded because behaviour a reader is trying to explain often comes from which components were in play, and nothing else on the ledger says.

host.description: The program that opened it, in its own words (e.g. "tui", "daemon"). Supplied by the host; the kernel has no notion of hosts.

cwd.description: The directory the host was started in — what tells one project's conversations from another's. Distinct from `workspace`, which is the confinement setting.
